items.headline: Pakistan ke pehle astronaut Tiangong pahunche
items.detail: Pakistan ke Muhammad Zeeshan Ali Shenzhou-24 mission ke saath China ke Tiangong space station par pahunchne wale pehle videshi astronaut bane.
items.exam_angle: China-Pakistan space sahyog, Tiangong — UPSC IR

items.headline: Cairo me tanker aag, 31 ki maut
items.detail: Cairo ki ring road par petrol tanker palatne se lagi aag me kam se kam 31 log mare gaye aur 21 ghayal hue, Egypt ke swasthya mantralaya ne bataya.
items.exam_angle: Egypt me badi sadak durghatna — UPSC IR

items.headline: Huawei ko America me doshi thahraya gaya
items.detail: Brooklyn court ki jury ne Huawei ko vyapar rahasya chori ki sajish aur bank dhokhadhadi samet 12 me se 10 aaropon me doshi thahraya, saza September 2027 me hogi.
items.exam_angle: America-China tech yuddh, pratibandh — UPSC IR

items.headline: China: Shanghai neta Chen Jining par jaanch
items.detail: China ne Shanghai ke party pramukh aur Politburo sadasya Chen Jining ke khilaf bhrashtachar ki jaanch shuru ki, do saal me giraye gaye chaunthe Politburo sadasya bane.
items.exam_angle: China ki rajneeti, bhrashtachar abhiyan — UPSC IR

items.headline: America ne nagrikon ko Iran chhodne ko kaha
items.detail: America ke Virtual Embassy ne nagrikon se turant Iran chhodne ko kaha, kyunki Iran aur Houthi ke hamlo ke baad ladai tezi se badhne ka khatra hai.
items.exam_angle: America-Iran tanav, travel advisory — UPSC IR

items.headline: Houthi ka Saudi ki sabse badi refinery par hamla
items.detail: Houthi ne Saudi Arabia ki sabse badi Ras Tanura refinery par hamle ka dava kiya; satellite tasveeron me dhuaan dikha aur tel ke daam 3.5% chadh gaye.
items.exam_angle: Khadi me tel suraksha, Houthi sangharsh — UPSC IR

items.headline: Solomon Islands ne Australia se suraksha sandhi ki
items.detail: Solomon Islands aur Australia ne sandhi par hastakshar kiye; Australia ab uska mukhya suraksha saathi hoga aur wahan koi videshi sainya adda nahi banega.
items.exam_angle: Prashant me China ka prabhav, suraksha sandhi — UPSC IR

items.headline: Dubai ke paas tanker ke kareeb dhamaka
items.detail: UKMTO ne bataya, Dubai se 50 nautical miles paschim me tanker ke paas ek agyaat projectile se dhamaka hua; tanker ko koi nuksan nahi, sabhi crew surakshit hain.
items.exam_angle: Gulf me samudri suraksha, UKMTO — UPSC IR

items.headline: Indonesia ki khadan me 13 ki maut
items.detail: Paschim Java ke Bogor me baarish se bhari ek avaidh sone ki khadan me 13 mazdoor mare gaye, 13 ab bhi 100 meter neeche fanse hain; bachav kaam jaari hai.
items.exam_angle: Avaidh khanan aur aapda prabandhan — UPSC

items.headline: SpaceX ko 10 lakh upgrah ki manzoori
items.detail: America ke FCC ne SpaceX ke 'Starmind' project ko antariksh me AI data centre ke liye 10 lakh upgrah bhejne ki manzoori di; pehla upgrah 2033 tak bhejna hoga.
items.exam_angle: Antariksh me AI data centre, FCC — UPSC S&T

items.headline: America: Bharat par 25% tariff ka prastav
items.detail: USTR ne Bharat se aane wale saaman par 25% tariff ka prastav rakha; yadi Bharat-America vyapar samjhota ho jaye to ye dar 17% tak seemit rahegi.
items.exam_angle: Section 301, Bharat-America vyapar — UPSC IR/Economy

items.headline: Ukraine ne Russia ke airbase par hamla kiya
items.detail: Ukraine ne Nizhny Novgorod ke Savasleyka airbase par hamla kar paanch vimaan ko nuksan pahunchaya — teen MiG-31 aur do Su-34; Ukraine ke General Staff ke mutabik hamla Budhvar ko hua.
items.exam_angle: Russia-Ukraine yuddh, deep strike — UPSC IR

items.headline: Netanyahu ke khilaf bhrashtachar case kamzor
items.detail: Jerusalem District Court ke judge ne kaha Case 4000 me Netanyahu ko doshi thahrana mushkil hai aur abhiyojan ko case wapas lene par vichar karna chahiye; Case 2000 par bhi punarvichar ki sifarish ki — ye faisla nahi, sifarish hai.
items.exam_angle: Israel ki rajneeti, Netanyahu mukadma — UPSC IR

items.headline: Cartagena me sabhi 20 bandhak bachaye gaye
items.detail: Colombia ke Cartagena me Exito supermarket me 17 ghante ki gherabandi ke baad suraksha balon ne sabhi 20 bandhakon ko bacha liya; ek hamlaawar mara gaya. Hamlaawaron ne bakhtarband gaadi lootne ki nakamyab koshish ke baad dukaan me sharan li thi.

items.headline: Abrego Garcia America se Spain pahunche
items.detail: Kilmar Abrego Garcia, jise Trump prashasan ne galti se El Salvador bhej diya tha, sweccha se America chhodkar Madrid pahunche; unhone kaha is baar ve aazadi ke saath ja rahe hain.
items.exam_angle: America ki immigration neeti — UPSC IR

items.headline: Macy's ki 100vi Thanksgiving parade tali
items.detail: Toofan ke kaaran New York ki 100 saal purani parade pehli baar tal gayi; ab Shanivaar 28 November subah 8:30 baje hogi.

items.headline: Bangladesh me 27-28 November ko deshvyapi band
items.detail: Pratibandhit Awami League ne 8 maangon ke saath band ka elaan kiya; Hasina 16 December ko lautne ki baat kar rahi hain, Dhaka ne giraftari ki chetavni di hai.
items.exam_angle: Bangladesh ki rajneeti aur Bharat-Bangladesh sambandh — UPSC IR

items.headline: Turkey me mahila hinsa ke khilaf hazaaron utre
items.detail: 25 November ko Istanbul me lagbhag 3,000 aur Ankara me 1,000 logon ne mahilaon ke khilaf hinsa ke khilaf pradarshan kiya, Taksim par pratibandh ke bawjood.
items.exam_angle: 25 November — Mahila Hinsa Unmoolan ke liye Antarrashtriya Diwas

items.headline: Riyadh tower par Houthi drone hamla
items.detail: Houthi drone ne Riyadh ke financial district ki ek tower par hamla kiya; 11 log ghayal hue, jinme 2 Bharatiya bhi hain; Bharat ne hamle ki kadi ninda ki.
items.exam_angle: Houthi, Saudi Arabia, West Asia — UPSC IR

items.headline: Trump ka birthright citizenship order roka
items.detail: America ke doosre judge ne bhi Trump ke birthright citizenship seemit karne wale aadesh par rok lagayi; ab prashasan ko dono faislon ko palatna hoga.
items.exam_angle: US 14th Amendment, birthright citizenship — UPSC Polity/IR

items.headline: Russia se riot gas rokne ki maang
items.detail: 34 deshon aur EU ne Russia se Ukraine yuddh me riot-control gas ka istemal turant rokne ko kaha; OPCW ki lab ne khaai me mile namoonon me CS gas ki pushti ki, Ukraine ne 2022 se 14,000 se zyada aise mamle darj kiye hain.
items.exam_angle: OPCW, Chemical Weapons Convention, CS gas — UPSC IR
items.image_credit: CEphoto, Uwe Aranas, CC BY-SA 4.0 (Wikimedia Commons)

items.headline: Ukraine ko $622m ke F-16 upkaran
items.detail: America ne Ukraine ke F-16 ladaku vimanon ke liye $622 million ke rakh-rakhav upkaranon ki bikri ko manzoori di; kharcha Belgium, Denmark, Netherlands aur Norway uthayenge, America ka koi paisa nahi lagega.
items.exam_angle: F-16, JUMPSTART, NATO sahyog — UPSC IR/Defence
items.image_credit: Staff Sgt. Cherie A. Thurlby, US Air Force, Public domain (Wikimedia Commons)

items.headline: Kyiv mall par ballistic missile hamla
items.detail: Russia ne der raat Kyiv par ballistic missile hamla kiya; Desnianskyi jile me ek shopping mall aur do aur imaratein nishana bani, kam se kam 4 log ghayal hue, jinme se 2 ki haalat gambhir hai.
items.exam_angle: Ukraine yuddh, ballistic missile — UPSC IR

items.headline: Lebanon ka doosra airport December me
items.detail: Lebanon ka doosra antarrashtriya airport — uttar me Qlayaat (Rene Mouawad) — 14 December se vyavsayik udanein shuru karega; Hezbollah ke kamzor prabhav ke baad khula ye airport pehle Turkey, Egypt aur Jordan ki udanein dega.
items.exam_angle: Lebanon, Hezbollah, West Asia — UPSC IR
